segments.text: Okay... I have a secret.
segments.acting_note: Leaning forward toward camera lens, conspiratorial eye dart, soft whisper cadence.

segments.text: Do not tell anyone.
segments.acting_note: Subtle finger-to-lips 'shh' gesture, quick blink, intimate eye contact.

segments.text: I have a partner.
segments.acting_note: Proud warm smile, slight head tilt, dark ink lock doodle clicks open.

segments.text: The person I met... is ADB.
segments.acting_note: Broad open palm gesture outward toward ADB. ADB strikes relaxed cool pose, blinks, gives tiny cute smile before settling into calm composure.

segments.text: We actually met during college, right in the middle of the COVID lockdown.
segments.acting_note: Explanatory hand gesture, laptop prop active, Wi-Fi doodle blinking.

segments.text: So basically... everything happened online.
segments.acting_note: Tapping laptop keys in short burst, comedic shrug, gaze shifting to viewer.

segments.text: And for two to three months? We just texted. Constantly.
segments.acting_note: Holding phone, eyes looking down smiling, chat bubble doodles bounce on screen, calendar pages flip.

segments.text: Messages all day... and random memes until three in the morning.
segments.acting_note: Hand over face with sheepish laugh, clock doodle sweeps to 3 AM.

segments.text: At first it was just casual chatting.
segments.acting_note: Both palms out, relaxed honest explanation.

segments.text: Then we realized... our brains are wired in the exact same chaotic way.
segments.acting_note: Eye contact with ADB, matching puzzle pieces doodle snaps together with satisfying click.

segments.text: And then... one day, we got drunk.
segments.acting_note: Conspiratorial pause, two doodled glasses wobble and clink, cartoon spinning stars appear.

segments.text: ...And things happened.
segments.acting_note: Sudden blackout stamp. Snap back instantly to Nemi and ADB side-by-side staring deadpan straight down the camera lens with horizontal dash mouths. Zero movement for 1.5 seconds.

segments.text: Look, ADB is really cute. Like, ridiculously cute.
segments.acting_note: Nemi gestures warmly toward ADB. ADB blushes with soft cheek flush, trying to maintain cool composure with a sheepish half-smile.

segments.text: And ADB is completely obsessed with anime.
segments.acting_note: Generic hand-drawn manga speed lines and sparkle doodles burst around ADB. ADB eyes light up with recognition.

segments.text: Which means we can talk about storylines for hours.
segments.acting_note: Both nodding together rapidly in shared nerdy hyperfocus, smiling enthusiastically.

segments.text: Now... does ADB irritate me sometimes? Absolutely.
segments.acting_note: ADB gives Nemi a playful side poke. Nemi gives a dry sideways glare with a tiny charcoal stress mark.

segments.text: Every single day.
segments.acting_note: Nemi folds arms firmly, straight dash mouth, shaking head.

segments.text: But I also irritate ADB every single day. So the balance is completely even.
segments.acting_note: Nemi acts goofy/ridiculous. ADB reacts with deadpan eyebrow raise. Both stare at camera. Hand-drawn balance scale locks at 50/50.

segments.text: Whenever things get chaotic, we're always backing each other up.
segments.acting_note: Illustrated vignette: Nemi helps ADB with study notes; ADB gives a warm appreciative nod.

segments.text: No matter what happens, we help each other through it.
segments.acting_note: Two-way connecting arrows draw between them; sincere, grounded eye contact.

segments.text: So yeah. My partner... and my absolute best friend.
segments.acting_note: Nemi looks at ADB with genuine affection, ADB smiles warmly back. Connected doodle figures draw beneath them.

segments.text: Okay... now you know. Keep it between us.
segments.acting_note: Nemi leans slightly in with a conspiratorial wink and soft secret tap to lens, holding pose in quiet stillness as scene gently fades.
